fusions.name: Bilge Spit
fusions.desc: Spits bilge water into the first enemy it meets; it deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Launched Off the Swell
fusions.desc: You spring up to 7 tiles onto an enemy and strike it, which deals 15 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Springboard
fusions.desc: Springs you 4 tiles forward, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Coiled at Anchor
fusions.desc: When your stamina fills, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
